record.name: Vlasov and Landau collision operator from Boltzmann
record.summary: The Vlasov equation is the collisionless mean-field limit of Boltzmann/BBGKY. Landau's collision operator is the grazing-collision limit of Boltzmann for the Coulomb potential, a Fokker–Planck form with Coulomb logarithm.

record.name: Colour Debye screening in QGP
record.summary: Screening of colour charge in the quark–gluon plasma gives a Debye mass m_D~gT, mirroring electromagnetic Debye shielding; the QGP is also characterized by a coupling parameter and collective modes.
record.breaks: Non-Abelian gauge fields add gluon self-interaction, and confinement physics has no EM-plasma counterpart; screening is perturbative only at high T.

record.name: Plasma accelerators as collider technology
record.summary: Wakefield gradients of ~GV/m to 100 GV/m promise compact TeV-class colliders, but energy spread, emittance, positron acceleration, efficiency and staging remain the barriers to a collider.
